title: papaver alpinum var. croceum
intro: Papaver alpinum var. croceum, commonly known as the Alpine Poppy, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Papaver alpinum var. croceum include sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as protopine and berberine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
